scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/types build && bun run --workspaces --if-present build
scripts.test: bun run test:release-tools && bun run test:types && bun run test:ts:bun && bun run test:packages && bun run --cwd packages/cli test && bun run test:complex-codec-bench && bun run test:bench-gate
scripts.test:ts:node: tsc -p examples/calculator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/crud/tsconfig.json && node --test dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/adapter-compat.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/cross-wire.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/payload-robustness.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/field-order-drift.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/generated-client.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/runtime-contract.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/transport-bench.test.js dist-ts/examples/crud/ts/*.test.js
scripts.test:types: bun run --cwd packages/types build && bun run --cwd packages/types test
scripts.test:packages: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/node test && bun run --cwd packages/node test:node-runtime && bun run --cwd packages/bun test && bun run --cwd packages/tauri test && bun run --cwd packages/react-native test && bun run --cwd packages/testing test && bun run --cwd packages/devtools test && bun run --cwd packages/react test
scripts.test:ts:bun: cargo build -p rustra-calculator-example -q && bun test examples/calculator/ts/*.test.ts examples/crud/ts/*.test.ts
scripts.test:runtime:node: cargo build --release -p rustra-calculator-example && tsc -p examples/calculator/tsconfig.json && node dist-ts/examples/calculator/apps/node-app.js
scripts.test:runtime:node-napi: bun run build:napi && tsc -p examples/calculator/tsconfig.json && node dist-ts/examples/calculator/apps/node-napi-app.js
scripts.test:runtime:tauri: bun run --cwd examples/tauri-calculator build && bun run --cwd examples/tauri-calculator smoke
scripts.test:adapters: bun run test:adapter:tauri && bun run test:adapter:react-native && bun run test:app:react-native
scripts.test:runtime: bun run test:runtime:node && bun run test:runtime:bun && bun run test:runtime:tauri
scripts.test:runtime:native: bun run test:runtime:node-napi && bun run test:runtime:bun-ffi
scripts.test:compat: bun run test:ts:node && bun run test:ts:bun && bun run test:adapters && bun run test:runtime
scripts.coverage:ts: RUSTRA_BUN_COVERAGE=1 bun test --coverage packages/types/src/index.test.ts packages/node/src/index.test.ts packages/bun/src/index.test.ts packages/tauri/src/index.test.ts packages/react-native/src/index.test.ts packages/testing/src/index.test.ts packages/devtools/src/index.test.ts packages/react/src/index.test.ts
scripts.release: bun run build && bunx changeset publish
